create_environment_wrapper: create an Environment wrapper around a gym env to track episode return, steps, and wins
use_minigrid2image_wrapper: use the Minigrid2Image observation wrapper to extract only the image channel from a Minigrid env
stack_frames_with_framestack: stack the last k frames from a gym env using the FrameStack wrapper for temporal context
optimize_memory_with_lazyframes: optimize replay buffer memory by using LazyFrames to defer concatenation of stacked frames
get_full_grid_observation: get the full Minigrid grid observation with the agent position marked in red
